title: Internet Not Working
content: Restart the router and check cable connections. If the issue continues, escalate to technical support.

title: Slow Internet Speed
content: Check connected devices, restart the router, and perform a speed test. Escalate if speed remains below plan limits.

title: Billing Dispute
content: Verify invoice details, payment history, and subscribed plan before raising a billing investigation.

title: Password Reset
content: Use the self-service reset portal. If account verification fails, escalate to account support.

title: SIM Activation Issue
content: Confirm SIM registration status and network availability. Escalate if activation exceeds 24 hours.

title: Network Outage
content: Check outage dashboard and affected region reports before creating a support ticket.

title: Plan Upgrade Request
content: Verify customer eligibility and billing status before processing a plan upgrade.

title: Connection Drops Frequently
content: Check signal strength, router logs, and line stability. Escalate recurring cases.

title: Payment Failed
content: Verify payment method validity and transaction status before retrying payment.

title: Router Configuration
content: Ensure correct WAN settings and firmware version. Escalate advanced configuration issues.

title: Mobile Data Not Working
content: Check APN settings, network mode, and account status. Escalate if mobile data remains unavailable.

title: Account Suspension
content: Verify payment status and policy violations. Restore service only after confirming account eligibility.

title: Duplicate Charges
content: Review transaction history and billing records. Escalate confirmed duplicate charges for refund processing.

title: New Connection Request
content: Verify service availability in the customer's area and collect required identity documents before processing.

title: Voice Call Quality Issue
content: Check network coverage, device settings, and recent outage reports. Escalate persistent call quality problems.
